description: This file is an initialization module for the 'gladia' service in the pipecat project. It imports the 'DeprecatedModuleProxy' class, imports all symbols from the local 'stt' submodule, and registers a deprecated proxy for the 'gladia' module.

classes.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy
classes.description: A proxy class that issues deprecation warnings or handles deprecated module access, imported from 'pipecat.services'.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for DeprecatedModuleProxy, initializes the proxy with the global symbols, module name 'gladia', and the specific submodule 'gladia.stt'.
